subject: SIG request: onboarding / offboarding evidence and sample artifacts
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@sigassessor.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Richards <tom.richards@brightline.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request: onboarding / offboarding evidence and sample artifacts

Hi Maya,

We're running the SIG intake for Brightline's procurement review and the assessor team has a few follow-up asks specifically about personnel onboarding/offboarding controls. Can you provide a small sample bundle (redacted) that shows the typical artifacts you retain for:

- Identity/background screening (sample redacted report)
- Training completion evidence for security & privacy (roster or certificate)
- Access provisioning mapping (what roles map to which systems)
- Deprovisioning evidence for at least one leaver (deprovisioning log)

We only need 1–2 redacted records and an accompanying runbook or checklist that shows your process. If anything is sensitive, an excerpt with clear redaction is fine. Also let us know retention windows and where these artifacts live (Drive, internal vault, HR system).

Thanks — target for Brightline is Wednesday 9 Jun EOD PT, if possible.

Regards,
Amanda Lee
Senior Assessor, SIG Intake
Sigma Assessors

--

On Mon, 07 Jun 2027 at 08:05, Tom Richards <tom.richards@brightline.com> wrote:
> Hi Amanda / Maya — following up on the SIG checklist. We want to be sure samples show both onboarding (hire) and offboarding (leaver) flows. Happy to redact PII.
> 
> - Tom

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@sigassessor.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request: onboarding / offboarding evidence and sample artifacts

Hi Amanda — thanks for the checklist. We can assemble a small bundle and share via a secure Drive folder. Plan:

1) Attach/redact: one background-check sample (redacted PII) — bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf
2) Training: export of security training completion for the hire (onboarding-training-roster-2026.csv)
3) Deprovisioning: entry from our access logs showing timestamped deprovisioning for a leaver plus the deprovisioning playbook (deprovisioning-log-2026.csv)
4) Process: latest onboarding-runbook-v2.md that contains the checklist and role-to-system mapping (sensitive system names partially obfuscated)

Retention: personnel vetting records are retained in the HR vendor for 7 years; training rosters are kept for 3 years in Google Drive; deprovisioning logs are retained in our identity provider for 2 years.

If that's acceptable I'll share a Drive link with view-only access and include a short manifest that points to the specific files and redactions. Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm there's no additional legal/HR gating for sharing these redacted samples?

Thanks,
Maya
Director, People Ops (Interim)
Redwood Inference

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request: onboarding / offboarding evidence and sample artifacts

Maya — we can proceed. A few operational notes for the assessor bundle:

- Use HR vendor redaction guidance (we redact DOB and SSN, keep hire date and role).
- Replace account identifiers with role-based tokens (e.g., "eng-2024-EXAMPLE") in the provisioning mapping.
- For the deprovisioning record, include the ticket reference and the IdP audit entry but mask exact usernames.
- Add a short attestation paragraph signed by HR stating the sample is representative of standard practice.

Jonas — please confirm IdP export that matches the deprovisioning timestamp and include the audit-id. We will share a Drive folder with MFA and view-only for Amanda.

Karthik
Head of Security & People Ops (coordinating)
Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@sigassessor.com>

Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 16:43:00 -0700

Maya / Karthik — this is perfect, thank you. We received the Drive link (view-only) and validated the redactions. Two quick asks before we close the evidence item:

1) Can you include the HR attestation as a separate short PDF (signed or e-signed)?
2) Please provide the IdP audit-id for the deprovisioning entry (we don't need raw logs, just the audit reference and confirmation of retention policy).

If you can drop those in the same folder, we can mark this item resolved on Brightline's SIG by tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — attaching a stub list of the files we saw: bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf, onboarding-training-roster-2026.csv, deprovisioning-log-2026.csv, onboarding-runbook-v2.md

Best,
Amanda Lee
